test_item:
The ECUCert Library shall expose a standard C++ API for certificate verification to support all native clients.
(CERT 2 corrupted in ecu.cacert)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. An ECU certificate chain is present on the DUT
proc:
1. Corrupt CERT 2 in file ecu.cacert on the host and push it to the DUT
$ adb push ecu.cacert /data/misc/ecuidentity/
$ adb push ecu.crt /data/misc/ecuidentity/
$ adb shell ls -l /data/misc/ecuidentity
2. Re-connect any internet or reboot, then confirm the ECU_CERT_SERVICE_FUNCTION_ID log
$ adb reboot
$ adb logcat -s ECU_CERT_SERVICE_FUNCTION_ID
er:
1. The adb shell ls -l /data/misc/ecuidentity output lists "ecu.cacert" and "ecu.crt"
2. The adb logcat -s ECU_CERT_SERVICE_FUNCTION_ID output contains "ECU_INSTALLATION_STATUS value : 2 -> 1"
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SYSAD_SEC_ECUCERT_ECUCERT_API Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
